properties.name: j-scheduler.execution.mode
properties.description: Execution strategy used by the auto-configured scheduler.

properties.name: j-scheduler.execution.platform-threads
properties.description: Number of bounded worker threads used in platform mode.

properties.name: j-scheduler.execution.max-concurrent-jobs
properties.description: Maximum number of simultaneous jobs in virtual-thread mode.

properties.name: j-scheduler.shutdown.timeout
properties.description: Grace period for ready and running work during application shutdown.

properties.name: j-scheduler.shutdown-hook
properties.description: Whether to register a JVM shutdown hook in addition to Spring lifecycle management.

properties.name: j-scheduler.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Whether to bind scheduler meters when a Micrometer registry is available.

properties.name: j-scheduler.health.enabled
properties.description: Whether to contribute scheduler health when Spring Boot health support is available.

properties.name: j-scheduler.declarative.enabled
properties.description: Whether to discover and schedule bean methods annotated with @ScheduledJob.
